title: Translating Variant Associations into Functional Insights Using the Knowledge Portal Network
summary: Did you miss our ancillary session at ASHG? View the slides here.
bodyHtml: Did you miss our ancillary session at the American Society of Human Genetics meeting in October 2019? We presented a session on how the Knowledge Portal Network can help accelerate progress in research on the basis of complex diseases. View the slides from that presentation here.
